epistemic_rule: These are recurring textual and structural parallels across the supplied public-post corpus, not proof of supernatural identity.

families.label: Garden, exile, gate and return
families.summary: Repeated garden-boundary, gate, seed, Door and return language forms a Genesis-to-Revelation restoration pattern.

families.label: Father, Son, time and return
families.summary: Timing, Father/Son language and return repeatedly cluster around eschatological passages.

families.label: Throne, footstool and boundary
families.summary: Above/below and inside/outside imagery repeatedly aligns with throne, footstool and exclusion motifs.

families.label: Wrestling and mirror
families.summary: A public formulation joins divine wrestling with mirror and self-recognition imagery.

families.label: Knowing and not knowing God
families.summary: Recognition and non-recognition recur as a theological frame.

families.label: Seed, hidden growth and multiplication
families.summary: Seed, hidden growth, multiplication and a small thing changing a larger system recur across separate posts.

families.label: Flood, mockery and judgment
families.summary: Flood and judgment language repeatedly appears near mockery and repentance themes.

families.label: Light, shadow and suffering
families.summary: Opposites such as light/dark, war/peace, captivity/freedom and pain/healing form a recurring wisdom pattern.

families.label: North, center, throne and foundation
families.summary: North and structural-center language has both positive and cautionary biblical comparators and should not be treated as automatically affirmative.

families.label: Narrow gate, Door, Lion, Root and House
families.summary: Several mature project motifs appear together in a dense public invitation cluster.

families.label: Stewardship, service and fruit
families.summary: Protection, service, repair and care for creation provide a strong biblical ethical comparator and fruit test.

countertext_rule: Where a post conflicts with strong biblical countertexts, preserve the disagreement instead of forcing harmony.
